records.title: COSA:Co-Operative Systolic Arrays for Multi-head Attention Mechanism in Neural Network using Hybrid Data Reuse and Fusion Methodologies
records.reason: The IEEE publisher endpoint required JavaScript/robot verification and did not expose the paper body; its record concerns systolic arrays for multi-head attention, but architecture and measured gains could not be verified.

records.title: Why is constrained neural language generation particularly challenging?
records.reason: The paper analyzes why constrained neural generation is difficult and evaluates constraint satisfaction; it is adjacent to generation/decoding work but does not establish a concrete efficiency improvement.

records.title: Exploring and Controlling Diversity in LLM-Agent Conversation
records.reason: The paper studies diversity in multi-agent LLM conversations and ways to control it; the objective and experiments concern interaction diversity, not inference resources.

records.title: S-STE: Continuous Pruning Function for Efficient 2:4 Sparse Pre-training
records.reason: S-STE learns a continuous pruning function for 2:4 sparse pretraining; it is a training sparsification technique, and practical inference acceleration is not demonstrated in the reviewed scope.

records.title: Pushing the Limit of Post-Training Quantization
records.reason: IEEE full-text endpoint returned only a JavaScript/robot verification page; although the available abstract describes Q-Limit/BRECQ/QDrop low-bit PTQ, the expanded paper's methods and evaluation could not be checked.
